denial.payer_remark: Documentation required: Sleep study report demonstrating medical necessity per policy criteria.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-03-10
Initial clinical sleep evaluation prior to diagnostic testing.
Patient reports severe nonrestorative sleep, daytime fatigue, and loud snoring.
Comorbidities: Refractory essential hypertension managed on lisinopril and amlodipine.
Order: Diagnostic polysomnography ordered.
Clinician: Arthur Pendelton, MD.

supporting_documents.text:
Study Date: 2026-04-05
Facility: Metro Sleep Diagnostic Center
Total recording time: 380 min. Total sleep time: 320 min.
Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI): 11.4 events/hour.
Oxygen saturation nadir: 88%.
Diagnosis: Mild obstructive sleep apnea.

expected.rationale: TESS-DOC-2.1 covers the device for an index from 5 to 14 when hypertension is documented and the clinician evaluated the patient before the study. The report gives an index of 11.4, the note records hypertension, and the evaluation on 2026-03-10 came before the study on 2026-04-05. The note is dated on the evaluation, not on the day the device was supplied.
